implemented: STAGE 3 family-1 reconciliation for TypeScript/JavaScript. rc2-ts (59cce85) already populated `kind` for TS/JS in the extract (families 2/4) and interface paths, but families 1 & 3 still diverged: `extractor.rs::classify_definition_node` (the (is_func,is_class) table that drives the `structure`/`definition` collection path via `collect_definitions`) did NOT recognise TS `type_alias_declaration` or `enum_declaration` on the class axis, so `structure` DROPPED every TS type alias and enum from `definitions[]`. Added a language-gated `TypeScript | JavaScript` arm to `classify_definition_node` setting `is_class=true` for those two node kinds (the canonical `entity::classify_node_kind` maps them to EntityKind::TypeAlias / EntityKind::Enum, both class-axis — used as the single source of truth), and added `"type_alias_declaration" => "type"` to the `collect_definitions` entry-kind switch (`enum_declaration => "enum"` already existed). JS is gated together but never produces these node kinds, so it is a no-op for JS. No new kind table was written; the change is sourced from classify_node_kind.
json_delta: `tldr structure <ts-file>` `files[].definitions[]` now EMITS the previously-dropped TS type aliases with `kind:"type"` and TS enums with `kind:"enum"` (e.g. for /tmp/rc2_ts.ts: Bar/Baz now present as kind:"type", Color now present as kind:"enum"). Same for the `definition` command which shares `collect_definitions`. Purely ADDITIVE: previously these entries were absent entirely (a drop bug); no existing definition's name/line/kind changed; interface/extract output unchanged (those paths do not call classify_definition_node and were already populated by rc2-ts). structure now AGREES with extract/interface on the type-alias kind.
char_tests: crates/tldr-cli/tests/rc2_meta_stage3_typescript_v1.rs::structure_emits_ts_type_aliases_as_kind_type (RED pre-fix: Bar/Baz absent from structure.definitions; GREEN: present, kind=type)
crates/tldr-cli/tests/rc2_meta_stage3_typescript_v1.rs::structure_agrees_with_interface_on_exported_ts_types (uses exported fixture; interface is the public-surface projection per rc2-ts export gate)

crates/tldr-core/src/ast/extractor.rs::tests::classify_definition_node_classes_ts_type_alias_and_enum (unit: family-1 now class-axis for the two node kinds, agreeing with classify_node_kind.is_class_axis)
lib_test: cargo test -p tldr-core --lib => 5266 passed; 0 failed; 342 ignored (includes the new unit test + the Stage-2 fourth-table guard `classify_definition_node_agrees_with_classify_node_on_fixtures` which now exercises the new TS type/enum rows)

Caused by the rc2-ts (59cce85) interface export-visibility gate which only recognises ES `export`, two commits before this one. The `interface` command does NOT call classify_definition_node; my diff does not touch interface.rs. PRE-EXISTING, unrelated.
isolation_proof: grep confirms classify_definition_node is invoked at exactly one production site: extractor.rs:2747 inside collect_definitions (structure/definition path). interface and imports commands use independent tables. My diff is +54 lines in extractor.rs only (plus a new test file). The two failing tests have byte-identical production paths to pre-change HEAD, so their pass/fail status is unchanged by this commit.
